name: Untamed
description: Widely regarded as one of the best roller coasters in Europe and a genuine world-class coaster experience — Untamed is a Rocky Mountain Construction hybrid coaster built on the structure of the former Robin Hood wooden coaster. Steel rails mounted on the classic wooden structure deliver relentless ejector airtime, whippy directional changes and 5 stomach-churning inversions across 1,085 metres of breathtaking track at 92 km/h. With 14 distinct airtime moments and a layout that never once lets up, Untamed became an instant legend when it opened in 2019 and remains the undisputed crown jewel of Walibi Netherlands. Min. height: 140cm.

name: Goliath
description: The tallest roller coaster in the Netherlands — Goliath is an Intamin Mega Coaster standing 47 metres tall and reaching 107 km/h across 1,214 metres of spectacular steel track. Designed by the legendary Werner Stengel in collaboration with Intamin, Goliath delivers seven intense airtime moments, a breathtaking Stengel Dive element and a horizontal looping that are the hallmarks of the finest Intamin hyper coasters. When it opened in 2002 it was the fastest, highest and longest coaster in the Benelux and it remains one of the most impressive steel coasters in the Netherlands. Min. height: 140cm.

name: Lost Gravity
description: A spectacular Mack Rides prototype coaster that was the first of its kind when it opened in 2016 — Lost Gravity stands 32 metres tall and reaches 87 km/h with two inversions across a uniquely designed 680-metre layout that features one of the most visually striking and physically intense first drops of any coaster in the Netherlands. The prototype status means the ride experience is unlike any other in the world with a unique combination of forces that continues to surprise riders on every visit. Min. height: 140cm.

name: Xpress: Platform 13
description: A ferocious Vekoma launched coaster that catapults riders from 0 to 90 km/h in just 2.8 seconds — one of the most violent and exhilarating launch sequences of any coaster in the Netherlands. Xpress: Platform 13 then tears through a Sea Serpent and corkscrew inversion while exposing riders to an eye-watering 5G force — among the highest on any coaster in the country. The dark industrial station theming and dramatic launch make this a must-ride for thrill-seekers at Walibi Netherlands. Min. height: 140cm.

name: Speed of Sound
description: A classic Vekoma Boomerang coaster with an extraordinary twist — an on-board soundtrack that makes the 5.2G forces even more powerful. Speed of Sound sends riders forwards through a Cobra Roll and loop then stops and sends them back through the same inversions in reverse at 75.6 km/h. The combination of six inversions, powerful g-forces and thumping on-board music creates a uniquely intense and memorable experience. Min. height: 140cm.

name: Condor
description: A historic ride — Condor is the world's first Suspended Looping Coaster (SLC) by Vekoma, a landmark moment in roller coaster history. Riders hang beneath the track with legs freely dangling as the coaster tears through 5 inversions at 80 km/h, 32 metres above the ground. The SLC format has been replicated at parks worldwide but the original at Walibi Netherlands remains a genuinely thrilling and historically significant attraction. Min. height: 140cm.

name: Blast
description: A high-energy launch ride that fires riders in a sudden explosive burst of acceleration — delivering the pure thrill of a violent launch in a compact and accessible package that is perfectly suited to riders who want intense sensations without a full roller coaster commitment. Min. height: 120cm.

name: Space Shot
description: A classic pneumatic launch tower that fires riders upward in a sudden explosive burst before allowing them to float back down in a series of gentle bounces — the Space Shot delivers a uniquely upward freefall sensation that is fundamentally different from a traditional drop tower and remains one of the most surprising and fun flat rides at Walibi Netherlands. Min. height: 130cm.

name: G-Force
description: A powerful flat ride delivering intense g-forces as riders are flung outward and upward in a stomach-compressing spinning and swinging experience. G-Force is one of the most intense non-coaster attractions at Walibi Netherlands and is a firm favourite with riders who want sustained g-force sensations between roller coasters. Min. height: 140cm.

name: Super Swing
description: A soaring swing carousel that lifts riders high above the park before spinning them outward at speed — delivering beautiful panoramic views of the flat Flevoland landscape and the surrounding festival grounds alongside the genuine thrill of height and centrifugal force. Min. height: 120cm.

name: Sky Diver
description: A classic flat ride that sends riders spinning and rotating at height in individual gondolas that flip and rotate freely as the ride spins — creating a completely unpredictable and disorienting experience where every ride feels different. Sky Diver is popular with riders who enjoy the random and uncontrollable nature of free-spinning gondola rides. Min. height: 120cm.

name: Spinning Vibe
description: A fun spinning flat ride with an energetic festival atmosphere — perfectly suited to the Festivalization theme of Walibi Netherlands, Spinning Vibe delivers rhythmic spinning sensations alongside upbeat music in a cheerful and accessible package. Min. height: 120cm.

name: Tomahawk
description: A classic pendulum swing ride that sweeps riders through a dramatic arc at increasing speed — one of the most popular and accessible thrill rides at Walibi Netherlands for families with older children wanting a taste of intensity without the full commitment of a major coaster. Min. height: 120cm.

name: Crazy River
description: A classic river rapids ride delivering exciting white water thrills and guaranteed soakings as circular rafts are swept through churning channels and over waterfalls. Crazy River is one of the most popular summer attractions at Walibi Netherlands and a firm family favourite for the hot Flevoland days. Min. height: 100cm.

name: El Rio Grande
description: A splashing log flume ride themed to the Wild West that sends riders down a dramatic final drop into a huge wall of water. El Rio Grande is one of Walibi Netherlands' most beloved classic attractions and perfectly captures the festive water ride spirit that makes theme parks wonderful on warm summer days. Min. height: 100cm.

name: Merlin's Magic Castle
description: A beloved family dark ride where Merlin the wizard battles the forces of darkness — guests board vehicles and travel through spectacular magic castle scenes filled with special effects, lighting and theatrical surprises. Merlin's Magic Castle is one of Walibi Netherlands' most charming and accessible attractions and a firm favourite with families who want atmosphere and story rather than pure thrills. Suitable for all ages.

name: Robin Hood
description: The legendary wooden coaster that gave rise to Untamed — Robin Hood's original wooden structure still stands and operates as a family wooden coaster experience while its famous steel track conversion became one of the best RMC coasters on earth. Robin Hood is a classic out-and-back wooden coaster delivering traditional wooden coaster thrills with genuine airtime and lateral forces that made it a beloved Walibi Netherlands icon for decades. Min. height: 120cm.

name: Boomerang
description: A fun family coaster delivering gentle twists, turns and a boomerang element that is perfectly accessible for families with children looking for their first real coaster experience. Boomerang is a classic family favourite at Walibi Netherlands and consistently popular with parents introducing younger children to the joys of roller coasters. Min. height: 100cm.

name: Eat My Dust
description: A Zamperla family coaster in the Speed Zone Off-Road area where riders race through a quad-bike-themed layout with gentle hills and turns — a perfect first coaster for families with children aged 4 and above who want their first taste of coaster excitement in a safe and fun environment. Min. height: 100cm.

name: Drako
description: A charming family coaster for the very youngest riders — Drako winds through a compact and colourful dragon-themed layout at gentle speeds, delivering the perfect first roller coaster experience for children from around 4 years of age. Drako is one of the most beloved starter coasters in the Dutch theme park scene. Min. height: 90cm.

name: Space Kidz
description: A fun space-themed family ride in the Speed Zone area where children take control of their own rocket ship and blast through a cosmic adventure. Space Kidz is one of the most popular interactive children's attractions at Walibi Netherlands and creates wonderful memories for families with young children. Min. height: 90cm.
